text: Gnome Bar Patrons are gnomes located in the Speedbarge Bar in Thousand Needles. If attacked with a Bottle of Grog#Horde, they will fight the nearby Goblin Bar Patrons.
Goblin Bar Patrons are goblins located in the Speedbarge Bar in Thousand Needles. If attacked with a Bottle of Grog, they will fight the nearby Gnome Bar Patrons.

The Gnomenapper is a tauren that can be encountered as a boss in the single-player experience in the The Witchwood expansion for Hearthstone. As his name suggests, he is obsessed with gnomes, which he kidnaps and stuffs into sacks.

Lemmy the Gnome in “Gnomo-plasty”! is an official trailer promoting the updated character models in Warlords of Draenor. It's the second of 4 videos to feature the gnome character Lemmy. It features art director Chris Robinson.
Goblin Cannon is a goblin cannon located in the Dagger in the Dark scenario.
Gnomeregan Mechano-Tank Pilots were gnomes located in Dun Morogh during the Operation: Gnomeregan as well as its aftermath stage.
Gnomeregan Multi-Bombers were bombers that participated in the Operation: Gnomeregan in Dun Morogh.
The Gnawed Wood Logs were to be an objective of NOT USED REUSE ME.
Gobby Nozzlerocket is a goblin who pilots The Uncrashable as it takes the player from Light's Hope Chapel to Fuselight-by-the-Sea in Fuselight, Ho!. He cannot be targeted or interacted with.
Goat's Milk is offered by Venrik during Raise a Glass! Drinking it raises Stamina by 10 for 1 minute.
Goat's Milk in a Skull Mug is offered by Venrik during Raise a Glass! Drinking it raises Stamina by 5% for 1 minute.
The Goat's Tote drops from Totes the goat at in Westwind Weald in Tiragarde Sound.
Goat Fur is obtained by shaving Gentle Goats with the Goat Shears in Tiragarde Sound.
Goat Shears is provided as an objective for Hold Still and Billy Goat Barber.
Gnomeregan Recruits are gnomes located in New Tinkertown and Toxic Airfield in Dun Morogh.
The Goblin Bazaar was a Goblin Merchant in Thunder Bluff in Mulgore.
Gnarlwood Waveboard is bought from the following vendors for : *Captain Klarisa in Tiragarde Sound *Captain Zen'taga in Zuldazar
Goblin Batteries are looted from Submerged Battery in the Spires of Arak.
Goblin Archaeologist is a goblin located in . She is disguised as a gronn, having put a skull on her head.
Goblet of Glittering Favor drops from Opulence in the Battle of Dazar'alor.
Gnomeregan's New Guardians is part of the Gnomeregan pet battle scenario.
Goblin Construction Crews are goblins repairing the roof of the Old Port Authority and the Stranglethorn Trust Bank in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Goblin Beast Wranglers are two goblins who are trying keep the wendigo Muk'luk on a leash at Arom's Stand in Drustvar during Faction Assaults.
The Goblin-Engineered Hand Cannon is provided as an objective for Thar She Blows!.

The Gnoll Targeting Barrel is a reputation reward; you must be with the Proudmoore Admiralty to purchase this item from Provisioner Fray in Boralus for . It summons a Gnoll Target Dummy in a Target Barrel.
Gnomish Net Launcher can be bought from the followers with the engineering trait in the garrisons for . It used to be sold by Miri Fiddlewizz in Boralus.
The Goblin "Mind Enhancer" drops from Warlord Surgios in Vol'dun. It is later found at ...
Gnomish Spider Tanks are mechano-tanks located in Tiragarde Sound.
Gnomish Bomb-bots are bomblings summoned by Shieldwall Engineers in Krasarang Wilds.
Gnomeregan Gunners were gnomes planned to be summonable during the second week of the Legion Invasions.

__NOTOC__ The Goblin Drone Dispenser is a piece of equipment brought by Rivett Clutchpop to the Jade Forest aboard the Sky Shark. It can be found near him at the edge of the crash site, offering the below quest only after players speak with Rivett during Higher Ground.

The Gnomish Elite Aerial Rangers (G.E.A.R.) are an elite gnomish aerial task force formed during the Fourth War, representing the best that Gnomeregan has to offer. Their uniform is the Heritage of Gnomeregan.
Gnarlvine Lashlings are lashers located on the Shrouded Shore in Vol'dun.

The Gnomeregan Assault Tank is created by de-shrinkifying the Shrinkified Assault Tank and is subsequently used to slay Ironbound Invaders in the Foot Steppes in the Storm Peaks during Gnomercy!. As soon as the player finishes killing 30 Ironbound Invaders, they are automatically ejected from the tank and flown to Terrace of the Makers with a Backpack Copter.
Gnarlwood Sentries are non-targetable wicker men located in Drustvar.

Gnomeregan Mechano-Tanks are gnomes operating mechano-tanks. They were used as Alliance troops during the Fourth War to participate in various missions. They were also encountered by Horde champions in Tiragarde Sound.
Gnome Elf Male Winter Revelers are gnomes located in Lunarfall.
Gnarlwood Barrier is a quest reward from world quests on Kul Tiras.
Gnarlwood Staff is a quest reward from world quests on Kul Tiras.
Gnome-Eating Slimes are oozelings located at the Outflow in Operation: Mechagon. Upon death, they burst into a group of Gnome-Eating Droplets.
Gnome-Eating Droplets are oozelings located at the Outflow in Operation: Mechagon. A group of them will spawn upon the death of a Gnome-Eating Slime.
Gnarlwood Dagger is a quest reward from world quests on Kul Tiras.
Gnarlwood Cutlass is a quest reward from world quests on Kul Tiras. It can also be contained in Kul Tiran Weapons Cache.
Gnarlwood Hammer is a quest reward from world quests on Kul Tiras.
Goblin Azerite Extractor is an extractor located in Winterdeep Basin in Tiragarde Sound.
Gnomish Azerite Extractor is an extractor located in Winterdeep Mining Camp in Tiragarde Sound.

The Gnomish Excavating Machines are a team of extractors drilling away at a collapsed tunnel near the southwestern entrance to Gnomeregan in Dun Morogh during Shadowed Halls and Dusty Cogs. They are overseen by a Sanitation Technician.
Gnomercy 4.U. is a siege engine located in Operation: Mechagon. It is part of the Tussle Tonks encounter.
The Gnomish Tonk Controller would presumably summon a Gnomish Steam Tonk.
The Gnomish Steam Tonk is a steam tonk that was likely summoned with a Gnomish Tonk Controller.
Goblin Cocktails are carried by Mine Bunnies in the Deadmines and by KTC Waiter and KTC Waitress at KTC Headquarters, on Kezan.
Gnomish Telebomb was to be provided for Disarming the Competition.

Go Ahead, Make My Daisy is a dungeons & raids achievement earned by defeating the Machinist's Garden in Operation: Mechagon without being struck by "Hidden" Flame Cannon, Self-Trimming Hedges, Discom-BOMB-ulator, or Roaring Flame on Mythic Difficulty.
The Goblin Apprentice's Belt was looted from the Satchel of Lost Belongings.
Gobbling Blossoms are lashers located in Tranquil Pools in Ardenweald.
The Gnomeregan Assault Battle Speech was never made available, but would likely have been used as part of Operation: Gnomeregan.
Goblin Bombardiers are goblin bombardiers located at the Slithering Cove outside Dragonmaw Port in the Twilight Highlands. They are seen working on cannons.
Gnomeregan Champions are gnomes located at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown during the Scourge assault in Death Rising.
Go Beyond! is the tier 3 transport network quest with Marasmius. There are multiple versions.
Gnawed Animacorns are looted from the Faerie Trove at the Path of Rebirth in Ardenweald.

Gnawed Ancient Idol can be found on the corpses of all creatures in Korthia, more likely on rare and rare-elite enemies (for Conquering Korthia), and inside other Relic Fragment-containing lootables around the zone. Turn the item to Archivist Roh-Suir at the Reliquary of Remembrance of Keeper's Respite for 8 Cataloged Research and 4 reputation with the Archivists' Codex.
Gnashtooth is a devourer battle pat contained in the Supplies of the Archivists' Codex paragon box from the Archivists' Codex faction in Korthia.
Gnomish Rebreather drops from Viscous Fallout in Gnomeregan.
The Gnawed Valise is a chest found atop a chipped pillar in the Genesis Fields in Zereth Mortis. Opening the chest will release three Compressed Mites.

Gnoklin Quirkcoil is a gnome located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken.
Gnashing Chompers is a soulbind trait granted by Emeni. It is exclusive with Gristled Toes and Sulfuric Emission.
Goat Brisket is sold by innkeepers and food vendors throughout the Dragon Isles.
Gnolls Must Die is a bonus objective taking place in Snowhide Camp in the Azure Span.
Gnomish Commandos are gnomes located in the Battle of Dazar'alor.
Gnawed Ley Crystals litter the ground of the Brackenhide Brambles in the Azure Span.

Gnolan's House Special drops from the following gnolls in Brackenhide Water Hole in the Azure Span: *Stormfang Grunt *Stormfang Dustcaller *Stormfang Hexspiter *Stormfang Bonecaster *Stormfang Shaman 20x are needed to obtain Temperamental Skyclaw from Zon'Wogi.

The Goblin All-In-1-Der Belt, or simply the rocket belt, is a type of trusty (relatively speaking) multi-tool belt worn by goblin adventurers. It does not visually appear in World of Warcraft, but its various gadgets are used in a number of racial traits and quests.
Gnomish Liquid Transfer Apparatus is available for purchase from the Trading Post during March for 75 Trader's Tender.
Goblin Barrage Balloon is a hot air balloon located near Dragonmaw Port in the Twilight Highlands.
Gnoll Tent is created by Dragon Isles Leatherworking (65); taught by Pattern: Gnoll Tent.
Goblin Beach Chair Seats are located in the Southern Barrens and Swamp of Sorrows.
Gnomish Voicebox is created with Dragon Isles Engineering (50); taught by Schematic: Gnomish Voicebox.
Gnoll Fiend Flail is located in a hut in the Upper Frostlands in the Azure Span.
Gnoll-Gnawed Breeches drops from: *Scav Notail *Blightpaw the Depraved *Blightfur *Mange the Outcast *High Shaman Rotknuckle *Sharpfang *Snarglebone
Gnollish Chewtoy Launcher drops from: *Scav Notail *Blightpaw the Depraved *Blightfur *Mange the Outcast *High Shaman Rotknuckle *Sharpfang *Snarglebone
Gnoll Hide Belt drops from Scav Notail in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Gnomish X-Ray Specs is a toy created and used by Gnomish Engineers, which allow the player to see other players without clothing and armor.

Goblin Engineering is one of two disciplines engineers may specialize in upon attaining level 30 and 200 skill. (The other is Gnome Engineering.) Its innovation is diverse with items ranging from Goblin Rocket Helmet and Goblin Bomb Dispenser to The Big One. This diversity can give Goblin Engineers the element of surprise and situational advantages when facing enemies.
__NOTOC__ Gold Ore is mined from Gold veins, with a minimum mining skill of 155.
Goblin Jumper Cables can be used to shock a dead player back to life. They have a success rate of 33% and a cooldown of 30 minutes.
Goblin Jumper Cables XL can be used to shock a dead player back to life. They have a success rate of 50% and a cooldown of 30 minutes.

:Goblin Workshop seem to be down, observed as of January 10 2011. Goblin Workshop was a World of Warcraft fan site with an extensive database of all sorts of things, similar to Allakhazam or Thottbot. The site was last updated on October 14, 2008 and last archived version was on [http://web.archive.org/web/20101123081009/http://goblinworkshop.com/ November 23, 2010]. Perhaps the primary distinguishing feature of Goblin Workshop was that in searching for any given item, it would say whether it was junk, a quest reward, professionally crafted, etc. Under each item, it indicated specifically which quest would award that item. It also had very good information on subzones, which was of value to

Goblin Rocket Helmet is a helmet that when activated causes the wearer to charge an enemy stunning it for 30 seconds. The side effect of this is that on impact the wearer falls down and is stunned for a few seconds.
Goblin Mining Helmet is one of the few items that can increase the wearer's mining skill.
Goblin Sapper Charge is a bomb that deals AoE damage to everyone around the caster, but also deals damage to the caster.
Goblin Rocket Boots are slightly terrifying pair of Goblin designed boots designed to aid in a quick getaway.
Goblin Land Mine can be placed on the ground and it will explode the next time a hostile target comes close to it.
Goblin Rocket Fuel is used in a variety of recipes, mostly engineering related.

.]] Gold Coast Quarry used to be a valuable mineral and gold mine in Westfall for the kingdom of Stormwind. As the region fell to ruins, the Defias Brotherhood once owned and patrolled the quarry for a long while, but since their defeat against the People's Militia, the quarry has been abandoned. Around the time of the Cataclysm, the mages Tannos and Karlain were sent here by Theocritus‎. The duo and the members of the People's Militia were then ambushed by Defias members.
Gold Scarabs are small gold figurines in the shape of a beetle.
__NOTOC__ Gold-Flecked Gloves drop from Glubtok in the Deadmines.

__NOTOC__ Godan is an orc artisan enchanting trainer located in the Drag in Orgrimmar. His shop is named Godan's Runeworks. During the Cataclysm, he served as Garrosh Hellscream's master enchanter. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen speaking with Kithas and Jhag.

Gol'Bolar Quarry is a large dig site found in southeastern Dun Morogh. It is the location of a small dwarven mining camp where young dwarves and gnomes can receive missions to exterminate the troggs who have overrun the excavation site and the Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine. There are also some vendors and profession trainers here ready to aid fresh-faced adventurers in any way they can. During the Legion Invasions, the area was invaded by the demons, but defended by Quarry Miners and adventurers. Some of the troggs were killed.

Golakka Hot Springs is a region in western Un'Goro Crater, just north of Terror Run. The area features geysers and pools heated by the nearby volcano. Spark Nilminer can be found at the top of a large geyser, while Maximillian of Northshire can be found at the base of the same one. Steaming Fury elementals patrol the shores of the pools.

The Gold Mine (also known by the acronym "GM" or simply "mine") is located in Arathi Basin and serves as a resource node. This gold mine can be captured by a member of the Alliance or Horde and once controlled, the mine provides a constant supply of resources to help either team win the battleground.

The Goblin Foundry lies deep in the Deadmines. It used to be occupied by goblins until the harvest golems came to life. The goblins of the foundry were working on a master project, the Foe Reaper 5000, an upgraded version of the Foe Reaper 4000.

Gold-Leaf Wildboots are epic leather boots that drop from Doom Lord Kazzak at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Hellfire Peninsula.

Goblin Woodcarver were level 18-19 elite goblins that could be found in the Mast Room of the original Deadmines. They used Axe Throw attack to stun you for 3 seconds. It was unresistable. They guarded the big Schredder with Sneed in it. The Goblin Woodcarvers were working in the mast room to cut wood for the building of the ship of Edwin VanCleef. Goblin Igniter is a quest reward from Venture Company Mining (Classic).

Goblin Sponsorship is a very long neutral quest chain which is based in the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles but sends players to Booty Bay and other distant locations. Two of the goblin team at the Mirage Raceway are the primary questgivers: the mechanic Pozzik and the pilot Razzeric. This quest is of particular note because the final rewards are on par with level 41 items, but all the quests can technically be received by players as low as level 29. This means that this quest is a must-do for ambitious leather and cloth wearing twinks in the 20-29 PvP bracket.

Goblins and gnomes have long had an intense rivalry. This competition has fostered a number of inventions designed specifically to show up the opposition. Nowhere is this better seen than at the racetrack in the Shimmering Flats, where the two sides rush endlessly to develop new racing vehicles — ones with little practical use anywhere else in the world. Gnomes and goblins have always been rivals — though whether this rivalry is friendly or brutal depends on the individuals involved.

The first thing a person thinks of when goblins come to mind is most likely not footwear. Yet the innovations that goblins have brought to the design of shoes for adventuring are undeniable. Goblin army boots take the design ethos of the goblin army knife and apply it to military footwear. Goblin army boots are sturdy leather boots that strap up to the knee. The heels are very thick, lending another 6 inches to the height of anyone wearing a pair. Contained within the heels of the boots are a number of devices that aid in jumping and traversing difficult terrain. The wearer can direct the boots to perform several tasks by manipulating a series of toe triggers. The soles of the boots contain

It was once a dwarven excavation site but, in the middle of a dig, the dwarves uncovered one of the underground caverns belonging to the troggs. The troggs pushed the dwarves out, and also took over the quarry outside of the mine. As opposed to the lower-level troggs in the outer quarry, this mine holds some of their strongest numbers which includes their leader, Hammerspine. Enter with caution! es:Mina Gol'Bolar

It’s not stylish and it’s useless as a weapon, but no sensible goblin warrior marches without this tool-of-all-trades. The goblin army knife digs trenches, saws wood, hammer nails, light fires, sounds three different kinds of duck calls, polishes and oils armor, sews clothing, stores 25 feet of spidersilk rope with a test weight of 100 pounds, extends into a fishing rod, and unravels into a 1-person canvas tent. All this utility in just 4 pounds, and it even cuts things.

Once essential for negotiating minefields, goblin mine shoes have been made obsolete by the goblin land mine. They remain exceptionally useful, however, for avoiding pressure plates, pit traps, and other hazards common to old ruins and abandoned fortresses. Goblin mine shoes are 2-foot wide metal plates that can be strapped onto any normal shoe. A system of gears and hinged plates prevents the shoes from interfering with normal walking and spreads the hero’s weight over a much wider area. This effect fives the character a chance to avoid any trap that is triggered by being stepped on.

The Goblin Slums was a district in Orgrimmar for the Bilgewater goblin refugees of Kezan opened after the Cataclysm. It connected to the Valley of Spirits, and was an oily, dirty place - similar to areas in Bilgewater Port. In addition to class and profession trainers, the area had its own innkeeper, auctioneer, and bankers. The space occupied by the Goblin Slums was originally part of the Valley of Spirits prior to the goblins joining the Horde. The trolls moved further north in the valley, while the goblins were given this part of the valley to use as their own. The slums were presided over by Boss Mida. Gods and Monsters is an exploration achievement earned for interacting with the lore objects on the Isle of Thunder the tale of the mogu's origins. Upon interaction with the fourth lore object, adventurers will immediately gain 2000 reputation with the Lorewalkers, and sends a letter via the in-game mail system: Attached is Gods and Monsters (item), which begins a quest, Gods and Monsters (quest).
Gold Rings can be picked up during Stage 7 of the Pursuing the Black Harvest scenario. It turns into a sellable version upon completion of Plunder the Black Temple.

Gold Shaman are fighters located at the Dalaran Arena in Underbelly. They represent PvP arena players.

Going To Need A Bigger Bag is a collections achievement earned for entailing a massive item collection hunt from nearly every mob on the Timeless Isle. A few items that previously only dropped from various Pandarian champions are available on the isle as well. If players had already looted one of those items (and still have it in their inventory or bank), they will get credit for that item automatically. Blizzard updated this achievement to function account-wide in Patch 5.4.8.
Godfrey may refer to: * Mayor Godfrey Goodard, the former mayor of Wintergarde Keep and a ghoul of the Scourge. * Lord Vincent Godfrey, a fallen lord of Gilneas and the master of Shadowfang Keep.

Goblin Glider is an engineer-only permanent "enchant" to cloaks. When activated, it unfolds into a glider that not only slows the engineer's fall, but also provides a small burst of thrust and can be steered in the air for up to two minutes, or until the engineer touches the ground. This can only be activated every three minutes. However, the tooltip for the schematic shows the effect as lasting only 30 seconds, with a five minute cooldown.
__NOTOC__ God-Hulk Gulkan is a dire troll found in the Troves of the Thunder King Scenario.
Gog'rak is an orc quest giver at Wor'gol on the Frostfire Ridge.

Goblin Siegeworkers are level 25 - 26 goblins found at the gate between Azshara and Orgrimmar.
Gol'kosh the Axe is an orc located at Bladespire Citadel in Frostfire Ridge.

Gogluk is a gronn guarding the Iron Worldbreaker on the in the instanced version of Tanaan Jungle, the Assault on the Dark Portal. He is carrying two Cannon Turrets. He must be defeated to climb the rear chains of the worldbreaker.
__NOTOC__ Gochar is a boar located at the Nest of the Ravenspeakers in Spires of Arak.

Gokk'lok is an enormous clam located in the sea at Gokk'lok's Grotto in the middle of Gokk'lok Shallows of the Dread Wastes. After the clam has been defeated, Promises of Gold will begin automatically.

Goggles is a gnome vendor and quest giver located outside of Elodor in .
The Goblin Shipyard is a neutral building used in Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne. This bustling yard full of Goblins is eager to sell you a transport ship capable of carrying units over water.
Goblin Noses are racial PvP tokens used for the quest Goblin Nose (quest) in order to receive a Dented Ashmaul Strongbox.
The Goblin Workshop, Level 2 is unlocked for being level 100 or having your Draenor outpost built.
The Goblin Workshop, Level 3 is unlocked from Terrific Technology for using at least 6 of the inventions available at the Workshop.
Goblin Mind Control Device is an item located at the Darktide Roost in .
Gold-O-Matic 9000 is a machine located at Stonecrag Gorge in .
Goblin Sailors are goblin workers on the submarine, The Verne in the Frostwall Shipyard.
Gok'tal is an ancient black rylak located at Daggermaw Ravine in Frostfire Ridge. It is summoned by using Raw Clefthoof Meat.
God-King Skovald's Fel-Tainted Coin is fished from the fountain in Dalaran at the Broken Isles.
Goc's Trophy is a quest reward from Strike While the Iron is Hot.
The Goblin Wench-Monger is one of the mascots for Kaja'Cola. His name is only mentioned in concept art.
The Goblin Sky Bombers are Gadgetzan goblins piloting hot air balloons during the Legion Invasions. They can be seen bombarding Burning Legion troops. They also appear in the Seething Shore.

Goblin Scouts are goblin scouts that are in Tanaris during the Legion Invasions. They could be found injured or being cornered by demons. Saving them would improve the score of defense against the Legion.
Goblin Explosives are provided as an objective for the following quests: *Explosive Results *What Once Was Lost
Golarb is an imp pet of the warlock Shinfel Blightsworn. When Shinfel was captured on Niskara, Golarb was struck down.
The Gold-Painted Rock is obtained by appraising the Shiny Gold Nugget with Rax's Magnifying Glass.

:The goblins of the Bilgewater Cartel once thrived on the Isle of Kezan. Although the goblins were forced to flee, this recipe made the journey with them to Kalimdor. They've added some more tropical ingredients since then, but these simple shortbread cookies will always remind goblins of their old home.
The Goblin Gas Tank was provided as an objective for Out of Gas.
Going Up is an exploration achievement earned from climbing the interior of the large statue at Nashal's Watch in Stormheim. The entrance inside is located just underneath Nashal's left arm.
Going On Seventeen was an achievement earned by reaching Honor Prestige Level 17.
This item was used to summon Ar'lia of the Moro'gai faction.
Goblin Rogue was a goblin located in . He was taken out by the followers sent from the Lunarfall garrison.
Gokk'lok Grotto is located in the Gokk'lok Shallows in Dread Wastes. It is the home of Gokk'lok and his protectors.
Gokk'lok Shallows is located off the shore of Rikkitun Village in the Dread Wastes. Gokk'lok's Grotto, the home of Gokk'lok and his protectors, is found here.

Gol Koval is a Drust ruin partially buried by a glacier in southeastern Drustvar. Hunter's Run and the Wayward Thicket lie to the north, while Fletcher's Hollow lies to the east. Undead Drust and their stone constructs have recently awakened in the ruins, and Thornspeakers have arrived to combat them.

Goblin Experimental Engineering Korporation is an organization of goblin engineers. When you choose to specialize yourself with goblin engineering, you automatically become a member of this organization. Any race can become a goblin engineer.
Gold Fever is an achievement earned for defeating Priestess Alun'za after defeating the Fatal Corruption in Atal'Dazar on Mythic difficulty.
Goblin Prisoners are goblins found in Rusty Cages in Sifreldar Village in the Storm Peaks.
A Goblin Smelting Pot is found in the Goblin Foundry of the Deadmines.

Goblin Mechanic is a goblin located in the Workshop of the Isle of Conquest. He gives Horde adventurers Seaforium Bombs and demolishers. He will also fix up the siege engines after a certain amount of time.

__NOTOC__ Gol Var is a Drust ruin located inside a cave system in northern Drustvar, only accessible through a tunnel entrance behind the Forgotten Lodge. It is full of seemingly inactive Drust revenants. A small chamber deep inside the ruin served as the ancient headquarters of the Order of Embers, and the Tome of Silver and Ash is hidden here. Knowledge of Gol Var and its secret entrance has been passed down through House Waycrest for thousands of years.

Gol Osigr is a Drust ruin on the western slopes of Mount Cortis in Drustvar, just south of Arom's Stand. Spirits of ancient Kul Tiran soldiers battle against undead Drust warriors and their runic constructs, as this is here that Gorak Tul's greatest soldiers made their stand during the final battle against the forces of Arom Waycrest. There are carved stones that depict the victories over Kul Tiran settlements and the battles between the two leaders built around the ruins.
The Gods of Zul'Aman trailer is the official trailer for The Gods of Zul'Aman Patch 2.3.
The Goblin Observatory was a goblin laboratory in eastern Durotar. Rexxar used it to spot the coming Kul Tiran forces.
The Goblin Storehouse was a Goblin Merchant in northern Durotar.
The Goblin Library was a Goblin Merchant in the area of the Coastal Base in Dustwallow Marsh.
Golanar is a huge hydra who wanders back and forth along the northernmost parts of the Shrouded Shore in Vol'dun while the world quest Golanar (quest) is available.
Goblin Sapper's Legguards can be purchased from Ransa Greyfeather in Dazar'alor for once with the Honorbound.
Goblins vs Gnome is an official Hearthstone: Goblins vs Gnomes web comic. It follows the two races trying to outwit each other. It was reprinted into Annual 2015.

Goblin Excavators are goblins of the Steamwheedle Preservation Society that accompany Gazmolf Futzwangler at the , Stonecrag Gorge, and the Ruins of Na'gwa in . One is disguised as a gronn, having put a skull on his head.
Goblin Supplies are found in the Lost Veil Anzu in the Spires of Arak. They also drop from the following goblins: *Deranged Plunderer *Infected Plunderer *Infected Mechanic
Goblin Lumberjacks are goblins located in Drustvar during the Faction Assaults.
Goblin Extractors are goblins located at Lornesta Mine in Darkshore.
Goblin Foremen are goblins located in Nazj'vel in Darkshore.
Goblin Incendiary Rocket Launcher is provided as an objective for Engines of War.
God King may refer to: *Rastakhan, sometimes referred with the title God King. *God-King Skovald

Gol seems to be a Vrykul word used by the Drust to call their territories: *Gol Var *Gol Koval *Gol Osigr *Gol Thovas *Gol Inath Additionally, gol seems to be an orcish suffix for calling an encampment after something: *Zeth'Gol *Wor'gol - translated as "Wolf Home". *Grom'gol *Mok'gol
Goblin Surveyor Jr. Grade is a goblin summoned by Surveyor's Beacon in Lake Mennar in Azshara during Survey the Lakeshore.
A Goblin Drum is found in the Drunken Drummer being drummed on by a Bilgewater Drummer. Others are located next to the Experimental Warboat in the Zocalo in Zuldazar during Only the Best Will Do.
